title: WE are the soldiers of Christ

lines.text: WE are the soldiers of Christ
Halleluyah
That the Lord hath founded on
His own
We‘re celebrating today Halleluyah
We are grateful for being alive.
Be cheerful soldiers of Christ
Sing aloud unto our King
Gratitude to our Saviour
Halleluyah
Lord for our survival till today.
All the folds in Kaduna Halleluyah
Give glory to our Father on high
For the soliders of Christ Band
Halleluyah
Which the Lord hath founded among you.
Tho satan will always try Halleluyah
To raze down this holy fold of God
But the Lord shall uphold Us Halleluyah
Glory be to our Father on high.
Thanks be to our Saviour Lord
Halleluyah
Who kept us alive since the year past
We beseech Thee O our Lord Halleluyah
Our lives to spare for many more years.
Jesus the head of our fold Halleluyah
Glory be unto Thy Sacred name
Please fasten up our waist band
Halleluyah
Like brave soldiers, advance and conquer
Let the whole fold shout aloud
Halleluyah
Glory be to our Father on high
Glory be unto the Son Halleluyah
All glory be to the Holy Ghost.
